name: Tremorsense (Magic Skull Games)
body:
School divination [earth]; Level: alchemist 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

Components: V,S, M (a spider’s leg)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Target(s): One living creature

Duration: 1 minute/2 levels

Saving Throw: Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

This spell endows the recipient with tremorsense, 15 ft. radius.
